versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the skill for turning vague game ideas into clear, actionable concepts.
- Guides teams through defining the core fantasy, primary player verbs, reward loops, and acceptance criteria.
- Provides a structured workflow to lock key design pillars before implementation begins.
- Includes templates and deliverables to document brainstorm results.
- Ensures focus and decisiveness, protecting the intended game experience from dilution.
